source_row.rationale: CDC's Protective Environment is specifically recommended for allogeneic hematopoietic stem-cell transplant patients to reduce exposure to environmental fungi using engineering controls such as HEPA filtration and positive pressure. It does not replace Standard or Transmission-Based Precautions and should not be generalized to every immunocompromised patient.
source_row.source_detail: Protective Environment recommendations: use for allogeneic HSCT patients to reduce environmental fungal exposure; maintain Standard and Transmission-Based Precautions as indicated.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Guideline for Isolation Precautions, Protective Environment
